privateVars.name: jobQueue
privateVars.description: RxJS Subject used as a job queue for book sync requests

privateVars.name: processing
privateVars.description: Set of book IDs currently being processed to prevent duplicate jobs

privateVars.name: bookRepository
privateVars.description: Repository used to upsert book records after syncing

functions.name: onModuleInit
functions.description: Initializes the queue processing pipeline on module startup

functions.name: addJob
functions.description: Adds a book ID to the sync queue if it is not already being processed

functions.name: processQueue
functions.description: Subscribes to the job queue with concurrent processing (max 3) and processes book sync jobs

functions.name: syncBookFromGoogleBooks
functions.description: Fetches book data from Google Books and upserts the record in the repository

functions.name: cleanDescription
functions.description: Strips HTML tags and decodes HTML entities from raw description text

functions.name: parseAuthorsAndArtists
functions.description: Parses author/artist roles from Google Books volumeInfo

functions.name: fetchFromGoogleBooks
functions.description: Fetches detailed book data from Google Books API for queue sync, returns null on failure
